This one-tap method needs the Shizuku app.

Install Shizuku (moe.shizuku.privileged.api), start it, grant it permission, then come back and tap APPROVE BY SHIZUKU again.

Alternatively use the ADB command from Option 1.
Shizuku is installed but its service is not running.\n\nOpen the Shizuku app and start the service (via wireless debugging or ADB), then come back and tap APPROVE BY SHIZUKU again.
This app is now the Device Owner.\n\nContinue to set up your daily retreat.
Make sure the phone was factory reset (or has no accounts and no second user) and was rebooted, then try again \u2014 or use the ADB command from Option 1.
Before your retreat can quiet the screen
Read this screen once, top to bottom. It is the only way into setup, and the back button is disabled here on purpose.
Everything the retreat does, in the order you will meet it. Nothing here needs technical knowledge.

In the setup console you choose how much screen-on time you allow yourself each day (for example 2 hours), the time of day the counter resets, and how many seconds of warning you get before the screen turns off.
Time is counted only while the screen is actually on. When the screen is off the clock is paused, so your allowance reflects real usage and not idle hours.

When your allowance for the current window is used up, the retreat shows a full-screen sanctuary and keeps you out until the next window begins. The retreat re-arms itself automatically after a reboot.
While the retreat is active a persistent notification shows your remaining time, counting down in lock-step with the sanctuary screen. It is a read-out, never a control.
Continue to setup, choose your values, confirm them, and the configuration is locked in. From that moment the settings surfaces are sealed.
After setup is locked, the console is reachable only on purpose: dial *#*#84635#*#* from the phone app and pass the biometric check. There is deliberately no PIN and no emergency release.
A direct-boot receiver re-arms the guardian the instant the system is up, before you even unlock the phone, so the retreat survives reboots without any manual step.

Approve these three permissions, one at a time
Each button opens the exact system screen for that one permission. The next button only unlocks once the previous one is confirmed \u2014 nothing is requested behind your back.

Set up your retreat in 4 steps
Four quick permissions and you are set. We will guide you through each one \u2014 tap a button, come back, and the next step unlocks on its own.
Tap the highlighted button, then come back here. Each tap opens the exact settings screen for that one item \u2014 nothing is requested all at once.
Keeps the retreat running after a restart.
